verdict.rationale: Docs reference an npx-based command (`npx supermemory setup`) that detects the project and launches an integration/setup flow, indicating an official CLI entry point exists, but all other interaction (add, search, manage memories) is documented via SDKs/API, not CLI commands. missing for 10: documented CLI subcommands beyond setup (e.g., add/search/list from terminal), independent/hands-on confirmation of the CLI's behavior, and a dedicated CLI reference page.
